entities.summary: Darrin Van Horn is an American former professional boxer who competed from 1984 to 1994. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) junior middleweight title in 1989, and the IBF super middleweight title from 1991 to 1992.
